about: GGUF and MLX downloads for open-weight LLMs in data/models.json (pass 12, checked 2026-10-11). Nothing under data/ was edited. Scope: category llm (or none), open_weights true, model_repo on huggingface.co; GGUF searched when no variant cmd contains ' -hf ', MLX when no variant runs mlx-lm/mlx-vlm on an MLX repo (Ollama '-mlx' tags do not count). Candidates: Hugging Face API filter=base_model:<canonical model_repo> with the gguf/mlx tag, every gguf/mlx repo in the maker's org, and (when that gives no maker/preferred-publisher repo) a name search limited to the maker and preferred publishers. Identity (identity_basis): 'base_model' = candidate cardData.base_model equals the catalogue model_repo (case-insensitive, or a former name that Hugging Face redirects to it, said so in identity); 'maker' = repo in the maker's own org with the base name plus a GGUF/MLX suffix; 'readme' = maker or preferred publisher with no base_model field whose README says 'converted to MLX/GGUF format from <repo>' / 'Original model: <repo>' and that repo is (or redirects to) the catalogue model_repo; 'self' = the model_repo itself holds GGUF files. In every case the candidate's repo name must be the base name plus only format/quant suffixes (bartowski-style '<Org>_' prefix allowed), so fine-tunes, merges, abliterated/uncensored, distills, QAT and other sizes are excluded; gated/private repos, multi-base merges, an explicit finetune/merge/adapter base_model_relation and licences contradicting the base are skipped. Publisher order (tier): maker, ggml-org, lmstudio-community, unsloth, bartowski (GGUF) / maker, lmstudio-community, unsloth, mlx-community (MLX), then 'other' by downloads. GGUF repo = first in that order with Q4_K_M (else a 4-bit alternative, else Q8_0, else for >=65B total params only a low-bit quant, else Q5/Q6), one repo per model; quants Q4_K_M and Q8_0 when present, plus for >=65B total params the smallest mainline Q3_K_M/Q2_K/IQ2_(XXS|XS|S|M)/UD-Q2_K_XL when it is under 85% of the 4-bit size. quant = the tag in the file name, as `llama-server -hf repo:TAG` takes it (matching is case-insensitive; a 40-entry sample was resolved through the Hugging Face llama.cpp manifest endpoint with 0 mismatches; tags with both a merged file and split parts use the set the manifest resolves). gb = all files of that quant (split parts included, mmproj excluded; mmproj records whether a projector file exists) / 1e9 from the tree at sha, 1 decimal (2 decimals when that would round to 0.0); bytes is exact. split true = sharded file set (Ollama cannot pull sharded GGUFs from hf.co). MLX: 4bit and 8bit repos (one each, same publisher when possible; else one fallback quant), quant from the repo name or, for bare names, config.json quantization; gb = all safetensors at sha; repos whose safetensors are far too small/large for the quant, or hold two shard sets, are skipped. Runtime check: GGUF general.architecture against llama.cpp master's src/llama-arch.cpp and MLX config model_type against mlx-lm / mlx-vlm main (arch, model_type, mlx_runtime); unsupported picks moved to not_found. downloads_count = Hugging Face's 30-day count on the check date. Extra fields: tier, identity_basis, last_modified, bytes, split, arch, model_type, mlx_runtime, mlx_vlm (repo has a processor config), size_flag (gb outside 0.7-1.45x of catalogue params x bits), runtime_note.
